Read-only; I did not run tests — I verified source and evaluated the recorded evidence.

## Production changes

### `MapContainer.ts` — early-camera buffering (correct)
- `setCenter()` buffers to `pendingCenter` only when the selected delegate is null **and** `isValidCenter()` passes (`:234-257`). `isValidCenter` (`:259`) rejects NaN/±Inf/out-of-range without clobbering a prior valid buffer — verified by the "invalid early coordinates cannot replace the last valid pending camera" test.
- Zoom spread `...(zoom !== undefined && Number.isFinite(zoom) && { zoom })` (`:242`) safely no-ops for `undefined`/non-finite zoom (spreading `false` is legal, no crash). Lat/lon `0` survive (finite, in range) — matches the zero-coordinate test.
- `replayPendingCenter()` (`:264`) reads the *current* `useDeckGL`, replays once, nulls the buffer. Cross-delegate handoff is sound: `initSvgMap` sets `useDeckGL=false` before replay (deck-fail→SVG path), so a camera buffered during a deck attempt still reaches the SVG delegate. All three init paths covered.
- `getCenter()` (`:365`) and `getState()` (`:395`) surface the pending camera before readiness; `getState` returns a fresh object and never mutates `initialState` (verified by the no-mutation test). `destroy()` (`:970`) clears the buffer.

### `vite.config.ts` — named `story-renderer` chunk (correct)
- Line `1069` sits **outside** the `node_modules` block, so `src/` ids reach it; `endsWith('/src/services/story-renderer.ts')` is exact-suffix and the config test (`story-renderer-chunk.test.mts`) proves it excludes `-helper.ts`, `other-`, `.backup`, and `components/story-renderer.ts` — good precision guarding against over-capture.
- Both consumers import statically, so the chunk stays statically reachable from main; consistent with the recorded 18/18 artifact pass and `bundle:check` green at 454.9 KiB.
